title: EmbeddingGemma Release
summary: Google introduced EmbeddingGemma on September 4, 2025 as an open 308-million-parameter embedding model designed for efficient on-device text embeddings.
significance: A dated release milestone for a compact Gemma-family embedding model intended for on-device retrieval and semantic-search workflows.

verification.note: Google's first-party Gemma release ledger records September 4, 2025 as the release of EmbeddingGemma in 308M parameter size. Google's same-day Developers Blog announcement independently introduces EmbeddingGemma as a new open embedding model with a 308M-parameter design. No development geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, priority claim, or relationship edge is inferred.
